title: Desert Frequencies
search: Desert Frequencies Music Sister A little louder, a little later. An evening of local live music, warm amplifiers and unhurried sets. Come early for the opening act and stay for the sounds you did not know you needed.

title: The Late Set
search: The Late Set Comedy Dry Heat Good company. Questionable stories. Settle in for a late-night lineup of local comics and new material. An intimate room, a relaxed host and enough time for one more story.

title: Tiny Prints, Big Ideas
search: Tiny Prints, Big Ideas Workshop The Paper Table Small blocks. Plenty of possibility. Make a miniature print from one small carving block. Experiment with simple shapes, then trade a print with someone at the table. workshops

title: Ink After Dark
search: Ink After Dark Workshop Barelas Print Studio A printmaking social. Carve a simple block, pull your first print, and settle into an easygoing evening around a shared studio table. Make something imperfect and entirely yours. workshops

title: Saturday on the Small Stage
search: Saturday on the Small Stage Music Sister Close enough to hear the strings. Three local acts share a small stage and a generous evening. Expect guitar-led sets, a little improvisation and room to find your favorite corner.

title: Sunday Paper Club
search: Sunday Paper Club Workshop Barelas Print Studio Bring an idea. Borrow some paper. Drop in with scraps, sketches or nothing at all. The shared table is open for collage, simple stamps and a few hours of making things together. workshops

title: Low Volume Sunday
search: Low Volume Sunday Music Warehouse Room A softer landing for the weekend. An early evening of acoustic sets with space between the songs. Come for one set or settle in for the whole session.

title: First Drafts & False Starts
search: First Drafts & False Starts Comedy Dry Heat New material, still finding its feet. Local comics try out fresh stories in a forgiving room. Some jokes will land, some will become better stories next week.

title: Postcards from the Neighborhood
search: Postcards from the Neighborhood Workshop The Paper Table Make something worth sending. Turn familiar streets, buildings and small observations into a set of hand-printed postcards. Simple designs are very welcome. workshops

title: Two Guitars, One Room
search: Two Guitars, One Room Music Warehouse Room An evening without much distance. Two songwriters trade short sets, favorite songs and the stories behind them. The room is small and the arrangements stay simple.

title: Midweek Mic
search: Midweek Mic Comedy Dry Heat A good reason to go out on Wednesday. A rotating host introduces a mix of familiar local voices and first-time performers. Expect short sets and a relaxed pace.

title: Black Ink, Bright Paper
search: Black Ink, Bright Paper Workshop Barelas Print Studio One color can do a lot. Explore contrast with dark ink and a stack of colorful paper. Cut a bold shape, adjust the pressure and see what changes from print to print. workshops

title: Songs for the Last Light
search: Songs for the Last Light Music Warehouse Room For the end of a long day. An intimate lineup of songs about home, leaving and getting there eventually. Local musicians perform stripped-back sets.

title: The Friday Reset
search: The Friday Reset Comedy Dry Heat Leave the week at the door. A hosted evening of local stand-up, everyday frustrations and useful perspective. Arrive early if you want to sit with friends.

title: High Desert Signal
search: High Desert Signal Sunshine Theater music Three fictional local acts share a bill of guitar-led sets and late-night electronics. Arrive for the opener, find a spot in the room and stay for the final set.

title: Carve a Creature
search: Carve a Creature Workshop The Paper Table Friendly monsters encouraged. Design a small creature and turn it into a repeatable paper print. There will be simple stamping options for younger makers. workshops

title: The Midnight Electric
search: The Midnight Electric Sunshine Theater music A fictional Halloween bill of synth-pop, live drums and a closing DJ set. A single sample ticket covers the evening; costumes are welcome in this demonstration.

title: Costumes & Feedback
search: Costumes & Feedback Music Sister A little strange. A little loud. Close October with a roomful of noisy local bands and homemade costumes. Dressing up is welcome, and entirely optional.

title: First Sunday Print Exchange
search: First Sunday Print Exchange Workshop Barelas Print Studio A fresh month at the shared table. Bring a few prints to exchange, or stop by to see what people are making. A small demonstration table is open to beginners. workshops

title: Sunday in Stereo
search: Sunday in Stereo Sunshine Theater music Two fictional songwriters trade sets in an early-evening show. The arrangements stay small, leaving room for the stories behind each song.

title: November, Quietly
search: November, Quietly Music Warehouse Room An early start to a new month. A low-key evening of local acoustic music. Short sets leave time to talk, listen and make plans for the weeks ahead.

title: Nothing Personal
search: Nothing Personal Comedy Dry Heat Stories that got a little out of hand. Local comics share opinions they probably should have kept to themselves. An easygoing Monday lineup with a host to keep things moving.

title: A Table Full of Zines
search: A Table Full of Zines Workshop The Paper Table Fold, print, share, repeat. Make a tiny folded publication using stamps, collage and a few handwritten lines. Leave with a finished zine and a few copies to trade. workshops

title: After the Record Store Closes
search: After the Record Store Closes Music Sister The listening continues. A pair of local bands bring their favorite influences into a live set. Expect familiar textures and a few things you have not heard before.

title: Setups & Second Chances
search: Setups & Second Chances Comedy Dry Heat The first version is never the last. A workshop-style comedy night where short sets get a second pass. Come for the stories, stay for the changes.

title: Friday Night Ink Club
search: Friday Night Ink Club Workshop Barelas Print Studio Clock out. Roll some ink. Spend a Friday evening making a small block print around the shared studio table. Bring a sketch if you have one; there are prompts if you do not. workshops

title: Voices on Central
search: Voices on Central Sunshine Theater music A fictional showcase brings a small choir, a soul trio and a spoken-word opener into the same room. Short sets make space to discover someone new.

title: Analog Hours
search: Analog Hours Music Sister Warm amps and a late finish. A night of guitar-driven local music, a few extended instrumentals and plenty of texture. The first set starts soon after doors.

title: Print Something for Someone
search: Print Something for Someone Workshop The Paper Table A small handmade gesture. Make a short run of simple prints to give away. Work from a personal symbol, a shared joke or a pattern that feels like someone you know. workshops

title: Small Room, Big Opinions
search: Small Room, Big Opinions Comedy Dry Heat Everyone has a theory. A Saturday lineup of local comics with strong views about very ordinary things. General admission seating keeps the room relaxed.

title: Sunday in Slow Motion
search: Sunday in Slow Motion Music Warehouse Room One more song before Monday. An early show of unhurried local sets. Bring someone who likes to listen, and leave with a little evening still ahead of you.

title: Beginner’s Block
search: Beginner’s Block Workshop Barelas Print Studio Your first print starts here. Start with the basics of carving, inking and pulling a print. The session moves slowly, with time to practice each step. workshops

title: Ten Minutes Each
search: Ten Minutes Each Comedy Dry Heat A few stories. A clear time limit. A quick-moving lineup gives each comic ten minutes and a chance to try something new. Drop in for an informal weekday show.

title: Desert Radio Live
search: Desert Radio Live Music Sister Local sounds, in the same room. A varied lineup moves from quiet guitar parts to a fuller late set. Come early to hear the whole progression.

title: The Art of the Imperfect Print: An Evening of Layers, Texture & Happy Accidents
search: The Art of the Imperfect Print: An Evening of Layers, Texture & Happy Accidents Workshop Barelas Print Studio Make room for the unexpected. Explore layered prints, uneven textures and the useful surprises that happen when ink meets paper. Bring curiosity rather than a polished plan. workshops

title: The Very Late Set
search: The Very Late Set Comedy Dry Heat For people who are not done with Friday. A late lineup of local stand-up and a relaxed host. Expect adult themes, short sets and a room ready for one more story.

title: Three Bands & a Borrowed Amp
search: Three Bands & a Borrowed Amp Music Sister A shared stage and a few new favorites. Three local bands split the evening with fast changeovers and distinctly different sounds. One admission covers the full lineup.

title: After the Last Train
search: After the Last Train Sunshine Theater music A fictional alternative-rock double bill with a local opening set. The evening builds from a quiet first song to a full-room finish.

title: Paper, Coffee & Company
search: Paper, Coffee & Company Workshop The Paper Table An unhurried morning of making. A gentle introduction to printing simple patterns on paper. Work at your own pace and enjoy the company around the table. workshops

title: Notes from the Group Chat
search: Notes from the Group Chat Comedy Dry Heat Some things sound better out loud. Local comics turn everyday messages, misunderstandings and family updates into an evening of stand-up.

title: Two Colors, One Block
search: Two Colors, One Block Workshop Barelas Print Studio A little planning. A little overlap. Try a two-color print with one simple block. Explore how small shifts in alignment and color change the finished image. workshops

title: Near the Speakers
search: Near the Speakers Music Sister For the songs that sound better live. An evening of local bands built around a small room and a close audience. Find a spot where the mix feels right to you.

title: Warm-Up Night
search: Warm-Up Night Comedy Dry Heat Fresh material before the weekend. A Thursday room for comics to test new ideas and audiences to discover a few new voices. The host keeps the sets short.

title: After Work, Make Something
search: After Work, Make Something Workshop Barelas Print Studio A different use for your hands. Put the workday aside and make a small set of printed cards. All the basic tools are ready at the table. workshops

title: The Neighborhood Listening Room
search: The Neighborhood Listening Room Music Warehouse Room A seat near a good song. An intimate evening of local songwriters and small arrangements. Between songs there is room for a story or two.

title: Handmade Holiday Cards
search: Handmade Holiday Cards Workshop The Paper Table Start with paper. End with a small stack. Print a personal pattern or a simple message onto a set of blank cards. There are plenty of non-seasonal prompts too. workshops

title: A Few Good Stories
search: A Few Good Stories Comedy Dry Heat The ones worth telling again. Local comics bring longer stories to a relaxed Monday room. Expect a little more detail and a few unexpected endings.

title: Print Swap & Studio Social
search: Print Swap & Studio Social Workshop Barelas Print Studio See what everyone has been making. An open studio evening for showing work, trading a print and asking questions. Come to browse even if you have nothing to exchange. workshops

title: Home for the Long Weekend
search: Home for the Long Weekend Music Sister Familiar faces, a shared evening. Local musicians and returning friends share short sets before the long weekend. One ticket covers the full evening.

title: An Open Door Session
search: An Open Door Session Music Warehouse Room Come in for a song or two. An informal afternoon of acoustic music. Stay for a short set or settle into a quiet corner for the whole session.

title: The Long Weekend
search: The Long Weekend Sunshine Theater music A fictional homecoming show brings three small bands together over the holiday weekend. Come early for a short acoustic opening set.

title: Leftovers & One-Liners
search: Leftovers & One-Liners Comedy Dry Heat A late show after a long week. A relaxed Friday lineup finds the funny side of family gatherings, too much food and unusual holiday plans.

title: Make Your Own Gift Wrap
search: Make Your Own Gift Wrap Workshop The Paper Table Good paper deserves a second life. Use simple stamps to turn plain paper into reusable wrapping sheets. Try a repeating pattern or make every sheet different. workshops

title: One More Sunday
search: One More Sunday Music Warehouse Room A soft close to the month. Finish November with a small lineup of local acoustic sets. An early start leaves time to get home without rushing.
